memory_sources.current_role: Reads markdown notes from configured or default local vault and returns safe excerpts with diagnostics.
memory_sources.read_only_boundary: obsidian_read_only diagnostic is true; code path reads files and returns excerpts only.
memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Default excludes include .obsidian/**, private/**, secrets/**, archive/**; token/email/secret-shaped values are redacted in excerpts.
memory_sources.future_use: Wrap as Phase 2 read-only Hippocampus source for task-relevant notes.

memory_sources.current_role: POST /v1/context/obsidian/query route for read-only note context.
memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Inherits safe excerpt and exclude-glob behavior from source_proxy/context/obsidian.py.
memory_sources.future_use: Candidate preview input for Phase 3 intake/context router.

memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Must not expose secrets or raw private context in future adapters.
memory_sources.future_use: Source registry for memory and context availability.

memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Future memory adapters must preserve safe inventory limits.

memory_sources.current_role: Default local markdown vault if present.
memory_sources.read_only_boundary: Read-only inspection only in v0.1 unless separately approved.
memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Use include/exclude globs and safe excerpts; never write back in v0.1.

memory_sources.current_role: Plan receipts, closeouts, diagnostics, and verification evidence.
memory_sources.read_only_boundary: Read-only source for future phases except the currently authorized evidence root.
memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Evidence can contain sensitive diagnostics; future adapters must prefer summary metadata and redact secret-shaped values.
memory_sources.future_use: Durable evidence memory for prior decisions and truth labels.

memory_sources.current_role: Durable coding run records including run IDs, prompts, status, model/provider fields, changed files, checks, and result labels.
memory_sources.privacy_boundary: Future adapters must preserve raw diagnostics by reference and avoid exposing full prompt/run payloads unnecessarily.
memory_sources.future_use: Run-history memory source for truth labels and prior failures.

memory_sources.privacy_boundary: No secrets expected; use as metadata contract.
memory_sources.future_use: Memory metadata must carry Phase 1 labels and unverified checks.
